primitives.name: Menu Combinatorial Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: 2026 Thanksgiving Package (Minimum 10 people) Harvest Salad with apples, craisins, candied pecans and champagne vinaigrette
primitives.assumptions: Fixed minimum party size N ≥ 10; discrete menu items; linear additive utility function over components.
primitives.breakdown_regime: N < 10 triggers invalidity; C ∉ {turkey, pork} causes constraint violation.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a set-partitioning problem where each item belongs to exactly one dietary category.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: total number of unique menu items selected per group.

primitives.name: Protein Selection Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Deep-Fried Turkey or Turkey Breast with Giblet Gravy or sliced pork tenderloin with a pear, honey
primitives.assumptions: Binary choice between turkey variants and pork; ternary choice for accompaniments.
primitives.breakdown_regime: P ∉ {turkey, pork}; T ∉ {fried, roasted}; A ∉ {gravy, pear-honey} leads to invalidity.

layer2.mapping: Derived from protein preference kernel with conditional dependencies on cooking methods and side dishes.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: frequency of each protein-accompaniment pair in orders.

primitives.name: Side Dish Aggregation Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: reduction Whipped Mashed Potatoes Sausage Dressing Twice Baked Macaroni and Cheese Candied Carrots or Green Bean
primitives.assumptions: Each dish is either mashed potatoes or mac and cheese; carrots or green beans are mutually exclusive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: D_i ∉ {potatoes, mac, carrots, beans} causes aggregation error.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a vector space over dish types with binary exclusion rules.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: proportion of each dish type in aggregate order.
